summary: Sandbach United kicked off their 2026/27 season with an exciting 2-1 victory over Wednesfield, with new signing Bevan impressing after scoring twice despite the team having five new players in the starting lineup. The match was competitive with Wednesfield equalizing through a lucky deflection just before halftime, but the Ramblers dominated possession throughout and restored their lead early in the second half. It was a great start to the campaign with plenty of chances created, and the team will be looking to build on this positive result as the season progresses.
